[P2] Preserve captured input fatals before checking admission

With an inline executor, an input deserializer can cross the admission cutoff and throw `InternalError` or `ThreadDeath`. The catch above saves that fatal in `inputFailure`, but this new check throws a lifecycle rejection before the saved failure is examined. The original fatal is consequently discarded instead of propagating as it does on the base branch. Classify and preserve fatal input failures before performing admission checks, without admitting additional user work, and add a regression for input deserialization that fails fatally after the cutoff.
